Calculation for heating:
- Temperature range: 2500K - 300K = 2200K
- Heating rate: 2.2 K/ps
- Time needed: 2200K / 2.2 K/ps = 1000 ps
- With timestep typically 0.001 ps (1 fs for metal units), that's 1,000,000 steps

<action_input>{"path": "/results/10_feb_melting/claude_45/react/melting/subtask/level_1/brief/silicon_melting_1_subtask_melting_trial_3/melting.in", "content": "# NPT melting simulation of Silicon
# Heat from 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data /results/10_feb_melting/claude_45/react/melting/subtask/level_1/brief/silicon_melting_1_subtask_structure_retrieval_trial_3/structure.data

# Replicate 3x3x3
replicate 3 3 3

# Define potential
pair_style sw
pair_coeff * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor settings
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Initialize velocities at 300K
velocity all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian

# NPT ensemble settings
fix npt_melt all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0

# Compute temperature and pressure for output
compute mytemp all temp
compute mypress all pressure mytemp

# Thermo output every 1000 steps
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

# Timestep: 1 fs = 0.001 ps
timestep 0.001

# Run for 1000 ps to heat from 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps
# 1000 ps / 0.001 ps = 1,000,000 steps
run 1000000

# Write restart file
write_restart /results/10_feb_melting/claude_45/react/melting/subtask/level_1/brief/silicon_melting_1_subtask_melting_trial_3/melt.restart

# End
print "Melting simulation completed"
"}</action_input>
